Locally bundled dependencies, so the dashboard works without a CDN:

- Three.js 0.169.0 (`three.module.js`, `addons/`), MIT. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r169
- urdf-loader 0.12.6 (`URDFLoader.js`, `URDFClasses.js`), Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/gkjohnson/urdf-loaders/tree/v0.12.6

Files were downloaded unchanged from the corresponding pinned npm packages. Licenses are alongside these files. The layout takes inspiration from the 3D viewer in https://github.com/yizhongzhang1989/ur15_crisp; application code and styles are implemented for this repository.
